verdict.rationale: Meilisearch ships as a single self-contained binary that can be installed and run locally in seconds with no external dependencies or account, and the runtime probe confirms a keyless local instance booting and successfully indexing/searching test documents — this gives AI-native users a trivial way to spin up an isolated non-production instance. However, there is no explicit vendor-provided 'sandbox' or staging environment feature (e.g., a hosted trial/sandbox project distinct from production Cloud projects) in the evidence. Missing for 10: a documented dedicated sandbox/staging mode or free trial cloud environment separate from production, and explicit guidance on isolating test vs prod data within Meilisearch Cloud.
